title: bodhavilasa — bodh-p02-v12
question: Its stages — views and the rest, all of them, no doubt. Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by his own will, so the bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-and-powers.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Its stages — views and the rest, all of them, no doubt. Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by his own will, so the bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-and-powers.

premises.text: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā tadvad eva cidānandasvecchocchalitabṛṃhitaḥ ātmā gṛhṇāti vipulā darśanādyā vibhūtayaḥ cidānandasamullāsollasitātmā virājate cidvatsvaśaktisaṅkocāt saṃsāre malināyate apūrṇo smīti vividhair malaiḥ sa malinīkṛtaḥ māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ śakto vikāsāc chaktīśo gīyate tattvavādibhiḥ saṅkocanāt saṅkocitaḥ saṃsārīty abhidhīyate māyā rūpaṃ hi yat kiṃcid ālokayitum udyatā sādhyasṛṣṭiṃ vijānīyād anyā śaktiḥ sthitir matā saṃhārāt saṃhṛtā devī cidaikye 'nugraho mataḥ tadekasārāprathanāt tirodhānābhidhīyate itthaṃ sadā saṃnihitaḥ pañcavāhavidhiḥ kramāt jñātaś cintāmaṇir asāv ajñānāt kāṣṭaloṣṭavat
